source_caption:
The unforgettable New Year’s Eve finale in When Harry Met Sally… almost didn’t exist. Director Rob Reiner originally planned a much sadder ending where the two characters never got together—but after falling in love during the making of the film, he changed the ending to the romantic New Year’s confession audiences now remember.

When Harry Met Sally… (1989), directed by Rob Reiner, starring Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher. A witty and heartfelt romantic comedy that explores whether men and women can truly be just friends, capturing love, timing, and the messy beauty of relationships.
